units.title: SG-5.1 Rebuild HeaderOverlay on the kit
Act: Restructure HeaderOverlay into logo, plaque and status pill with dot
Act: Add gold button variant, header suggest button and App wiring
Act: Render loading, error, empty states in the pill and group icon controls
Verify: Header bar, plaque, pill with dot and countdown unit tests

tests.name: pill holds dot, id and status
tests.title: HeaderOverlay status pill shows round id, status and a dot reporting the status
tests.scenario: Given a ready round round-1 with status OPEN, when HeaderOverlay renders, then round-pill contains round-1 and OPEN and round-dot has data-status=OPEN

tests.name: plaque and logo
tests.title: HeaderOverlay shows the world title in a plaque, the StoryForge logo, brass-corner header and one timer
tests.scenario: Given a header for The Boy's Room with a ready round, when rendered, then the title's closest data-frame=plaque is not null, StoryForge is present, header-bar has sf-brass-corners, and exactly one role=timer exists

tests.name: HeaderOverlay round info
tests.title: HeaderOverlay shows logo, world, round id, status and timer
tests.scenario: Given a ready round for The Boy's Room, when rendered, then StoryForge, world title, round id, status and timer are shown

units.title: Verify: Suggest button opens the contribution dialog unit tests

tests.id: headerSuggest.test.tsx::HeaderOverlay suggest button::clicking the suggest button calls onSuggest once
tests.name: clicking the suggest button calls onSuggest once
tests.title: HeaderOverlay suggest button: clicking the suggest button calls onSuggest once
tests.scenario: Given the header shows a ready round and an onSuggest handler, when the player clicks 'Suggest What Happens Next', then onSuggest is called once and the button text is '+ SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT' with class sf-btn-gold
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerSuggest.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx::App header suggest button::renders one suggest button inside the banner
tests.name: Given the game is begun, when the header renders, then exactly one Suggest button sits inside the banner
tests.title: App header suggest button: exactly one Suggest button is inside the banner
tests.scenario: Given the game is begun, when the header renders, then exactly one Suggest button sits inside the banner
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx::App header suggest button::opens the contribution dialog
tests.name: Given the game is begun, when the player clicks Suggest, then the contribution dialog opens
tests.title: App header suggest button: clicking Suggest opens the contribution dialog
tests.scenario: Given the game is begun, when the player clicks Suggest, then the contribution dialog opens
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx::App header suggest button::Escape returns focus to Suggest
tests.name: Given the contribution dialog is open, when the player presses Escape, then focus returns to the Suggest button
tests.title: App header suggest button: Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to Suggest
tests.scenario: Given the contribution dialog is open, when the player presses Escape, then focus returns to the Suggest button
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appContributionFocus.test.tsx::App contribution focus::Escape returns focus to trigger
tests.name: Given the contribution sheet is open, when the player presses Escape, then focus returns to the Suggest trigger
tests.title: App contribution focus: Escape returns focus to the Suggest trigger (existing)
tests.scenario: Given the contribution sheet is open, when the player presses Escape, then focus returns to the Suggest trigger
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appContributionFocus.test.tsx::App contribution focus::Close returns focus to trigger
tests.name: Given the contribution sheet is open, when the player clicks Close, then focus returns to the Suggest trigger
tests.title: App contribution focus: Close returns focus to the Suggest trigger (existing)
tests.scenario: Given the contribution sheet is open, when the player clicks Close, then focus returns to the Suggest trigger
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeaderSuggest.test.tsx tests/appContributionFocus.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: Header loading, error, retry, empty and icon control unit tests

tests.name: headerKitStates.test.tsx > HeaderOverlay pill states > shows the loading pill with no timer while the round is loading
tests.title: shows the loading pill with no timer while the round is loading
tests.scenario: Given the round is loading, When HeaderOverlay renders with loading, Then round-pill data-state is loading, text is 'Loading round…', and no timer is shown

tests.name: headerKitStates.test.tsx > HeaderOverlay pill states > shows the error pill with an alert and a Retry button that calls onRetry once
tests.title: shows the error pill with an alert and a Retry button that calls onRetry once
tests.scenario: Given error 'Round service returned 500' and onRetry, When Retry is clicked, Then data-state is error, the alert reads 'Round unavailable: Round service returned 500', and onRetry is called once

tests.name: headerKitStates.test.tsx > HeaderOverlay pill states > shows the empty pill with the no-active-round message when there is no round
tests.title: shows the empty pill with the no-active-round message when there is no round
tests.scenario: Given no round, loading or error, When HeaderOverlay renders, Then round-pill data-state is empty and text is 'No active round'

tests.name: headerKitStates.test.tsx > HeaderOverlay pill states > toggles sound and opens settings through the header icon controls in the store
tests.title: toggles sound and opens settings through the header icon controls in the store
tests.scenario: Given a loaded round with sound on and settings closed, When Toggle sound and Settings are clicked inside the 'Header controls' group, Then uiStore soundEnabled is false and settingsOpen is true

tests.name: headerOverlayStates.test.tsx > HeaderOverlay states (existing, 3 tests)
tests.title: existing header loading, error and empty state tests still pass
tests.scenario: Given the existing header state tests, When run, Then all 3 pass

tests.name: headerRetry.test.tsx > HeaderOverlay retry and success states (existing, 2 tests)
tests.title: existing retry and success state tests still pass
tests.scenario: Given the existing retry tests, When run, Then all 2 pass

tests.name: headerOverlayControls.test.tsx (existing, 2 tests)
tests.title: existing header icon control tests still pass
tests.scenario: Given the existing header control tests, When run, Then all 2 pass

units.title: REQ · Header is a wood bar with brass corners, gold logo, world plaque, status pill with dot and countdown
REQ · Gold + SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT header button opens the contribution dialog
REQ · Pill and icon controls cover loading, error with retry, empty and sound and settings states
Evidence: HeaderOverlay kit, suggest button and state unit tests pass
